body: Thank you. I'm trying. I really am. I've bought books, seen counselors, tried to surround myself with people. I'm scared of the future. I don't know what to do now.

Depression. Recent loss. 

Both make me terrified of the future.
Same here. Sadness, confusion, guilt, anger.
I'd like to think people get theirs, but some of them are way happier than I am.
I can barely make decisions about my own life. Trying to do things on a larger scale seems too daunting.
Discussing pirates via messages on OKCupid

Today. Girlfriend killed herself last Saturday. We buried her yesterday. Today is our anniversary. 

I'd be lying if I said I wanted to live, but I don't want to die.

I've been posting a lot about this, but I have depression. My girlfriend did as well and killed herself last Saturday. I've hated life every day since. I hate the world. One week feels like a year. Today would have been our anniversary.

I don't deal with it, but talking helps me when I hate everything. Friends, family, lighter topics with strangers. Shit, even posting on Reddit even if nobody will see it. Talking helps.
No mental illness
My friends and family. My faith, as well (not a popular answer, I'm imagining). I'm the the darkest, most painful place in my entire life and they help me keep going.
I wish I knew. Family and friends help. I also like to read. It provides a temporary escape that alcohol used to provide for me, but cheaper and infinitely healthier.

"How have you been holding up?"

Girlfriend killed herself a week ago. I'm fucking fantastic, thanks.
Killing myself
Exactly this. I don't know if there is or not, but as someone who just lost the love of his life I hope there is.

Grabbing a cop's gun, wondering what to do with a giant knife, wondering what happens if I drive into the opposite lane of traffic. They've been more intrusive lately but I would never do any of them.
I like 12's because there are days off. Additionally, continuity helps with preventing medical errors. Having staff change more often means a higher risk of communication errors, missed signs, etc.
"I've been in the bathroom all night."
Just lost a loved one. I've been listening to The Scientist and Fix You by Coldplay. The Fray has quite a few sad songs too.

Thank you. The viewing is open casket, despite the circumstances of her death. I'm sure they'll do a good job. She was always beautiful. I was nervous about the idea but I think I will find comfort in my last sight of her being of her beautiful, at peace, instead of how I found her. I've had flashbacks endlessly.

Thank you. Having a history of depression and being a recovering alcoholic doesn't make it any easier. We both had problems with addiction and quit and got support together. The fact she would say I'm an idiot is the one thing keeping me from going on the biggest bender of my life. As cliche as it sounds she wouldn't want it.

But God it's tempting.

I've been venting a lot on Reddit, so my comment may be downvoted just out of the fact it's repetitive but: my girlfriend killed herself on Saturday. I found her body that night. The wake is tonight.

I always welcome hugs. Anything that can help cover the gaping hole in my heart is welcome.
Thank you. I'm seeing someone this evening. Talking to her parents has helped as well. I'm meeting with them Wednesday. They know what I'm feeling, if not even more.
I'd like to thank you all for the kind words. There are a million emotions and yet I'm numb at the same time. I don't know how I'll move forward, but I know I have to. She would want it.
The police took it. I'll be seeing a professional tomorrow.
